hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.aios/guard.py" && exit 0; exit 2; fi; done; echo "AIOS guard: no working python3, python or py was found, so every action is blocked. Install Python 3 (see START_HERE.md)." >&2; exit 2
for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.aios/session-start.py"; fi; done; exit 0
